traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements from docs/stories/010.1-DEV-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS.story.md are implemented and verified by passing tests. The valid-annotation-format rule now supports nested and flat configuration of storyPathPattern/requirementIdPattern plus associated example strings, validates regex patterns with clear configuration error reporting, falls back to safe defaults on error, and exposes a proper JSON Schema for ESLint configuration. Extensive tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts are explicitly tied to this story and exercise custom patterns, example overrides, invalid regex handling, and precedence between nested and flat options. No regressions or integration issues with valid-story-reference are observed, and all jest suites pass, so this story is assessed as PASSED.
